prompt:
Visitor: My team keeps saying an idea is 'not feasible' when I think they actually mean it's not desirable. How do I tell the difference before we kill a good idea for the wrong reason?

Which reply would you rather receive? Type A or B in the feedback box (or "same" if you really can't tell), then a few words on why if you have a reason. Example: A - shorter, easier to follow.
